_comment: Context-Hub MCP server configuration template for Claude Desktop / Claude Code.
_usage: Copy the 'mcpServers' block into your Claude Desktop config at: ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json
_auth_note: MCP stdio auth is not enforced in v0.1.0 (localhost-only operation). CONTEXT_HUB_API_KEY is NOT required and will be ignored. Full auth (bcrypt + ConsumerRepository) will be added in v0.2.0.
